text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest single-digit gains, with BTC holding stronger momentum than ETH, suggesting selective appetite for the largest assets. The Fear & Greed index is in Greed territory at 65 but has declined 6 points over a week, indicating sentiment peaked recently and may be consolidating. Bitcoin's 59.5% dominance and $73B in 24-hour volume point to a market with healthy trading activity but no panic buying or euphoria—conditions typical of a steady, risk-on period without extreme conviction.
